videos.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
videos.description: Katerina and Mauricio are looking for one property in Canada and a holiday home in Belize, specifically on a private island. Real estate broker Tea Haxhillari helps the couple with their search in Canada as well as with private island hunting.

videos.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
videos.description: Fernando and his investment group are looking to either buy or build a resort in Canada or Mexico with the help of Joe Petrella Construction. Tav Schembri offers the investors a stunning property with potential in Canada.

videos.title: Blue World
videos.description: Jonathan Bird shares his seven-day experience staying on Rock Island's luxury boat.

videos.title: Blue World
videos.description: In the tropical paradise of Palau, the Blue World team explores World War II era shipwrecks. Then they travel to the Philippines in search of one of the rarest cephalopods in the world: the Mimic Octopus.

videos.title: The 30//10 Challenge
videos.description: Sam and Nate accept a challenge set by another extreme sports athlete: Geraldine Fasnacht.

videos.title: Find Me a Classic
videos.description: Mat travels Europe on the trail of a very special 1960s Mini.

videos.title: Find Me a Classic
videos.description: Mat tracks down one of the most desirable convertibles on the planet: the Mercedes SL Pagoda.

videos.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
videos.description: Vinnie and the team are working in the paint booth on the Malicious Intent. The 1966 Mustang is sanding out the car to get it ready for the paint booth. The 86 Camaro is being converted into a sniper system under the hood.

videos.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
videos.description: Vinnie is working on replacing the gages on this 1975 Corvette. The rocker panels on the 1964 Corvette are ready to be reinstalled.

videos.title: Morbidelli Rising
videos.description: There's danger on the track at the year's biggest race, Mugello. Franco battles to focus on his goal of 'Rookie of the Year' while around him his team implodes.

videos.title: Morbidelli Rising
videos.description: Franco continues to claw back points and has a nail biting wait to find out if he has won Rookie of the Year. Will he be riding again next year?

videos.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga
videos.description: Last year's champion Erik Miller defends his title; 2nd place finisher Jason Scherer will be one of the many top challengers aiming to beat him.

videos.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga
videos.description: We follow Shannon Campbell, the first 3-time champion of the King of the Hammers. But his kids, also young drivers, push their dad to the brink of his limits.

videos.title: Geared Up
videos.description: The team does a restoration modification of a 1964 Mercedes-Benz 230 SL, adding custom-made wheels and a modern engine.

videos.title: Geared Up
videos.description: A 1970 K5 Chevrolet Blazer undergoes a transformation with new paint, wheels, interior, and a diesel engine conversion.

videos.title: Graveyard Carz
videos.description: The ghouls install the exhaust, door windows, taillights, rear valance, body plugs and gills on the infamous '71 Phantom Cuda.

videos.title: Graveyard Carz
videos.description: Mark announces a top-secret project to the ghouls and Alyssa surprises her dad when she manages to get him his old car for Father's Day.

videos.title: Close Proximity
videos.description: Diving into a world of cars, trucks, and tire burn through the unique life of professional drift car driver Matt Field. He and his team head to Long Beach in California to begin the Formula Drift Championship series.

videos.title: Close Proximity
videos.description: Following the life of a professional drift car driver. Coming off a good start to the Formula Drift Tour, Matt Field and his crew prep, pack, and fly to Atlanta for the next stop of the championship.

videos.title: The Flying Kestrel
videos.description: The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930s Riley Kestrel, with the intention of restoring it and then breaking the land-speed record. This series follows the events from restoration to record day.

videos.title: The Flying Kestrel
videos.description: The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930s Riley Kestrel, with the intention of restoring it and then breaking the land-speed record. This series follows the events from restoration to record day.

videos.title: Inside Moto
videos.description: Walk the fine line to success, from Alberto Puig's life-changing accident, to the astonishing sponsorship deal of the Laglisse Champions' Squad.

videos.title: Inside Moto
videos.description: Discover how Maverick Vinales and Alvaro Bautista face the loneliness of being champions. Maverick chooses to let go of family support and ties, while for Alvaro, family is key.

videos.title: The Ride Life With Sung Kang
videos.description: Sung explores Chicago's car culture despite its harsh winter and crime reputation.

videos.title: The Ride Life With Sung Kang
videos.description: Sung returns to his home town Los Angeles, the car culture capital of the world.

videos.title: FMX Nomads
videos.description: Join Dan Whitby, Samson Eaton, and Arran Powley for a day in the life of globe-trotting freestyle motocross team, Bolddog.

videos.title: En Route to Endurance
videos.description: Andy Soucek competes in the Bentley Continental at the 2018 Total 24 Hours of Spa, held at the prestigious Spa-Francorchamps circuit.

videos.title: En Route to Endurance
videos.description: We are introduced to Ahmad Al Harthy as he competes in the Aston Martin Vantage at the 2018 Total 24 Hours of Spa, held at the renowned Spa-Francorchamps circuit.

videos.title: 7 Days
videos.description: Kevin and Jalou are both in Canada. They travel from Vancouver to snowy Whistler for the final challenge: ski mountaineering.

videos.title: Photonis Ultimate Forces Challenge
videos.description: The teams face a classic water obstacle course.

videos.title: Photonis Ultimate Forces Challenge
videos.description: Today is one of the most important days in the competition. One of the teams will be forced to leave the competition.

videos.title: Rhino Orphanage
videos.description: The crisis intensifies as poachers turn their attention to orphanages.

videos.title: Power &
videos.description: Charlie Pomroy is the football-crazy British Head Coach of Soltilo Angkor FC, a professional football team in Cambodia's top league. We meet Charlie and his star-player Sophal, as they train and prepare for the local derby.

videos.title: Power &
videos.description: Meet women's freestyle football World Champion Aguska Mnich. Under the gaze of the iconic London Eye she is about to compete against 3x World Freestyle Record Holder Ben Nuttall. It's the ultimate freestyle girl vs boy battle.

videos.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino
videos.description: Francisco Porcella displays the unquenchable spirit that drives the desire to chase big waves.

videos.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino
videos.description: The best of the big wave surfing community wrap up an amazing El Niño season with the XXL Big Wave Awards in Anaheim, California.

videos.title: No Time to Lose
videos.description: The contestants begin their adventure across South Africa by competing in a spectacular waterfall race and also in a race across African plains whilst being chased by a helicopter.

videos.title: Return of the Spider Monkeys
videos.description: A spider monkey named Infinity was stolen from the forest as a baby. Now, after an eight-year rehabilitation, she is ready to return to the wild.

videos.title: Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale
videos.description: Telling the true story of a baby elephant born into a rescue camp in the Botswana wilderness, who became orphaned after a month. The keepers of the camp work hard to become surrogate mothers for the little one.

videos.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?
videos.description: Terry goes back to paratrooper school to see how difficult it was for soldiers engaging the enemy while parachuting down to safety on D-Day. He will attempt with three different weapons to hit several targets while descending from the air.

videos.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?
videos.description: Terry gets to relive part of his military career by attempting the famous sniper shot from 'Saving Private Ryan' and Larry and Terry demonstrate how sniper technology has developed over the years.

videos.title: I Am Invincible
videos.description: Not all injuries are visible on the surface, and some scars run deeper. Ruth Freeman battles cancer every day, while Damien Irish suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder.

videos.title: I Am Invincible
videos.description: Though paralysed, Rob Bugden is gearing up for the Invictus Games. For Jari Ylanen, his PTSD makes entering the stadium a challenge in itself.

videos.title: MTB Heroes
videos.description: Meeting one of the most famous and talented MTB photographers in New Zealand and following him during the biggest competition in Rotorua as he captures the riders in action.

videos.title: Spartan X
videos.description: Following the action that will decide who survives the coming battles, who will have to leave the competition, and who will be the first finalist.

videos.title: Spartan X
videos.description: The contestants decide who will win the 40,000 euros first prize and claim the ultimate title.

videos.title: Story of Masters
videos.description: Dan Fogler is on a journey to meet the masters of martial arts. From ancient teachers to fighters in modern arenas, the influence of the masters stretches through history and is still being written today.

videos.title: Story of Masters
videos.description: Dan Fogler is bringing things into the now for the final chapter of his journey into martial arts: he's searching for the ways that modern audiences engage and enjoy these ancient practices. From the excitement and drama of MMA arenas to legends of cinema like Bruce Lee and Korean director Crazy Doo - how will the next generation be inspired to become Masters?

videos.title: Modern Explorers
videos.description: Jokke, Niccolo and Espen travel to China where they participate in a wingsuit flying competition. The platform they jump from is just like the mountains: gigantic.

videos.title: Modern Explorers
videos.description: Exploring how Espen, Jokke and Niccolo manage to stay alive while wingsuit flying, which is amongst the most dangerous sports in the world.

videos.title: Orphans of the Wild
videos.description: It's a year later and things have changed; Marlice and Rudie have a new baby boy, and he needs to be introduced to the animals.

videos.title: Orphans of the Wild
videos.description: While looking for the three missing caracals, Kiewiet finds suspicious-looking human tracks; Rudie and Flo investigate and believe the tracks belong to a poacher; Rudie, Kiewiet and Flo do a stakeout from a watchtower and later apprehend a suspect.

videos.title: Wild Edens
videos.description: A celebration of India and Bangladesh's most pristine habitats and their rarest and most spectacular wildlife. During times of global climate change, countless species face challenges to their survival as the environment changes around them.

videos.title: Strange World
videos.description: Alex Hannaford heads to South Australia to investigate a terrifying rodent infestation. In 1993, rural communities were engulfed by hordes of mice which drove people from their homes.

videos.title: Epic Exploring
videos.description: Cody experiences the 'Island life' on the Isle of Wight, England, a heaven for urban exploring including a medieval lighthouse and a derelict holiday resort.

videos.title: Epic Exploring
videos.description: Local exploring in industrial Charleroi, Belgium, brings Cody to abandoned factories and an unknown spot full of colourful graffiti. An old casino awaits to be explored.

videos.title: Travel With a Goat
videos.description: Two foodies travel through Bulgaria with a sheep, they must decide whether to have the animal slaughtered after spending three days with it.

videos.title: Travel With a Goat
videos.description: Two foodies travel through Sicily with a donkey; they must decide whether to have the animal slaughtered after spending three days with it.

videos.title: Access All Areas
videos.description: Francesca Chiorando travels to Sunny Beach, Bulgaria to find out if it is a holiday heaven or hell.

videos.title: Love of the Wild
videos.description: A reflection on the connection each naturalist shares with the wild places they call home. Stories of resilience, survival and dedication to nature. As they look forward, each naturalist reflects on the profound.

videos.title: Luxe Travels
videos.description: Host Liesel Hlista embarks on a mission to understand how Balinese blend hospitality with luxury.

videos.title: Ultimate Processes
videos.description: Francesca finds out for herself just how good today's mobile homes can be. She visits one UK company who specialise in producing top-of-the-range vehicles.

videos.title: Ultimate Processes
videos.description: Francesca visits two companies making wooden houses. One makes flat pack homes for assembly, while the other specialises in creating beautiful wooden frames.

videos.title: Streetkings in Jail
videos.description: Street footballer Edward van Gils meets up with Brazilian legend, Gilberto Silva. They head to Fundação Casa, a youth prison in São Paulo, to see how the next generation of football talent uses the game to escape tensions between gangs and police.

videos.title: Streetkings in Jail
videos.description: World-class street footballer Edward van Gils meets up with Dutch legend Ruud Gullit in his old neighbourhood in Amsterdam. They're heading to Veenhuizen prison to explore how they use the beautiful game as a method of rehabilitation.

videos.title: Power &
videos.description: Darius Lewis is an American professional football player who plays in one of Europe's smallest competitions on the remote Danish Faroe Islands. We meet Darius and his family as he introduces them to his new life as a professional football player.

videos.title: Power &
videos.description: Lorenzo Taddeucci plays in an ancient Calcio Storico tournament, a brutal and violent form of historic football from the Italian city of Florence. We follow Lorenzo's team in preparation for the semi-finals against their rivals.

videos.title: The Garms Dealer
videos.description: Jack Grealish is after some new gear from Sam. He's looking for some particularly 'out there' threads and has a last-minute request for some vintage items.

videos.title: The Garms Dealer
videos.description: England's rising star Declan Rice is after some new drip from his old mate, the Garms Dealer. The two have been mates for years, and Dec shares a secret about his lucky trainers.

videos.title: Secrets of the Brain
videos.description: Explore the science of hypnosis and persuasion and discover how even a hardened sceptic can be convinced, Dr Jack himself included.

videos.description: Have you ever got a song stuck in your head? Marty Music sat down with Dr Carole Scherling, a neuroscientist from Belmont University, to talk all about sticky lyrics and the science behind why some catchy tunes get stuck in our heads.

videos.description: With hundreds of different species of frogs, birds, mammals and reptiles, Honduras is one of the most species-rich countries in Central America. During his journey through the country, Nigel Marven investigates its abundant wildlife.

videos.description: Nigel Marven goes to Costa Rica, a paradise with more than 1,250 species of butterflies, 800 species of birds and 240 species of mammals. This makes Costa Rica the Central American country with the greatest biodiversity.

videos.description: Following divers who explore blue holes in the Bahamas and high current divers in Palau.

videos.description: Jonathan Bird, explores Cozumel, Mexico, a diver's paradise with clear water, reefs, and sea turtles.

videos.title: Extraordinary Humans
videos.description: Freediver Tom Sietas holds his breath as he submerges for a death-defying 22 minutes.

videos.title: Ghost Chasers
videos.description: A sceptical Cody investigates a haunted theatre located in the South of England. The stage is set, the lights are off. Let's hunt and explore the other side.

videos.description: An exploration of Château de Fougeret in Loire Valley, France, includes dancing tables and a talking Ouija board.

videos.description: The final 16 head to St. George's Park and the squad face their first challenge in a match against English Universities FC. Plus, Casey Stoney leads a comprehensive defensive masterclass.

videos.description: In a series of masterclasses, Andros Townsend showcases what makes him one of the best players in the Premier League, and England superstar Lucy Bronze passes on her winning mentality.

videos.description: With all the rain came an abundance of animals. To count them, Rudie takes to the air, but only after saving a cheetah's life on the operating table.

videos.description: Peter Trego plays on a dust-bowl pitch in the Kenyan Savannah, where giraffe and zebra graze just beyond the boundary.

videos.description: Terry and Larry will test three scenes from Denzel Washington's 'Equalizer' films. Terry tries to be as cool as Denzel and use propane tanks and a microwave to create an explosion, use a staple gun to take out a bad guy, and more.
